papers.title_en: FidelityQ: Preserving Predictive Fidelity in Ultra-Low-Bit Language Model Quantization
papers.authors: Yujie Chen, Weiyan Zheng, Yiwu Yao, Tianchi Hu, Bo Wang, Jiyu Guo, Wenzhan Li, Jingcai Guo, Michele Magno, Haotong Qin
papers.evidence: 用随机Hadamard混合整形权重以减轻离群值影响
papers.tldr: 超低比特标量量化可提升大模型部署效率，但在2比特等极端精度下保持预测一致性仍困难。FidelityQ通过信息对齐解析编码将权重行塑造成中心对称源，并用镜像四级最小失真量化器实现无查表解码。它进一步用知识密集校准，按教师-学生散度尾部挑选样本，仅更新量化层级与尺度。在LLaMA-2-7B上，W2A16的WikiText2困惑度为6.62，W2A4KV4从8.31降至6.96，线性层权重内存较FP16缩小8倍。
papers.abstract_en: Ultra-low-bit scalar quantization offers a regular arithmetic structure for efficient deployment of large language models, but preserving predictive behavior at extreme precision remains challenging: with only a few reconstruction levels, accurate weight representation must translate into consistent predictions from a small calibration set. We propose FidelityQ, a scalar quantization framework that preserves predictive fidelity at weight precisions down to 2 bits. For accurate quantization, we introduce Information-Aligned Analytic Coding (IAC), which shapes each weight row toward a centered symmetric source via randomized Hadamard mixing and fits a mirrored four-level minimum-distortion quantizer to its empirical weights. Every level set in this family decomposes exactly into two sign-valued bases with associated scales, combining source-adaptive reconstruction with lookup-free decoding compatible with scaled integer arithmetic. Our analysis further shows that residual predictive discrepancies are heavy-tailed and concentrate on tokens the teacher predicts confidently, motivating Knowledge-Intensive Calibration (KIC) for consistent quantization. KIC ranks sequences by the tail of token-wise teacher-student divergence, allocates a limited calibration budget to the highest-scoring samples, and restores predictive agreement by updating only quantization levels and scales under teacher supervision, keeping pretrained weights frozen. Experiments on the LLaMA and Qwen families demonstrate the effectiveness of FidelityQ in weight-only and joint quantization settings. On LLaMA-2-7B, FidelityQ achieves a WikiText2 perplexity of 6.62 at W2A16 and improves the prior state-of-the-art W2A4KV4 result from 8.31 to 6.96, while reducing linear-layer weight memory by 8.0x relative to FP16.

papers.title_en: SAGE: Pushing 2-Bit Vector-Quantized LLMs toward Real-World Usability
papers.authors: Xianglong Yan, Zenan Wu, Kewei Zhang, Kaicheng Yang, Yulun Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向大语言模型的极低位仅权重量化
papers.tldr: 极低比特权重量化可降低大模型部署成本，但3比特以下标量量化精度损失严重，现有向量量化在真实任务上仍明显退化。SAGE针对敏感通道保护与固定比特预算分配，提出能量分层分组和自适应比特拆分。它在2比特设置下取得领先结果，Qwen3-30B-A3B保留BF16平均分95.3%，定制CUDA核实现最高2.55倍端到端加速。该工作提升了2比特向量量化LLM的实用性并开源代码。
papers.abstract_en: Extreme low-bit weight-only quantization is an effective approach to reducing the deployment costs of large language models. Below 3 bits, scalar quantization often suffers severe accuracy loss, while vector quantization (VQ) better preserves accuracy through more expressive joint encoding. However, existing VQ methods still exhibit substantial degradation on real-world tasks, and two design challenges remain underexplored: (1) protecting sensitive weight channels within jointly encoded vectors; and (2) allocating a fixed bit budget among representation components, such as direction and radius, to suit different weight matrices. To address these challenges, we propose SAGE: Split Adaptation and Grouping by Energy for weight-only vector quantization. First, Energy-Stratified Grouping (ESG) couples channel grouping with activation-weighted fitting, grouping channels from different energy tiers within each subvector to prioritize sensitive channels. Second, Adaptive Bit Split (ABS) balances direction-codebook capacity and radius precision per matrix, selecting the split with the lowest activation-weighted reconstruction error under a fixed budget. Across benchmarks covering knowledge, mathematics, code generation, instruction following, and tool use, SAGE achieves state-of-the-art performance in the 2-bit quantization setting. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, it retains 95.3% of the BF16 model's average benchmark score. With our custom-designed CUDA kernel, SAGE delivers up to a 2.55-fold non-streaming end-to-end speedup over FP16. The code is available at https://github.com/Zincwolf/sage.

papers.title_en: KV4-RL: Unlocking Faster Asynchronous Rollouts for RLVR with INT4 KV Cache Quantization
papers.authors: Sihwan Park, Sung-Yub Kim, Doohyuk Jang, Eunho Yang
papers.evidence: 面向高效LLM推理的INT4 KV缓存量化
papers.tldr: 异步RLVR的rollout受长尾生成拖累，持续并发又使KV负载集中。论文提出KV4-RL，对KV缓存做免校准INT4量化，并对attention sinks和近期上下文选择性保留INT8。Qwen3-8B GRPO训练400轮取得1.80倍累计rollout加速、1.27倍全迭代加速，末50轮rollout加速达1.97倍。六基准平均准确率与BF16训练相差0.5个百分点内，说明低精度KV可兼顾速度与学习稳定性。
papers.abstract_en: Asynchronous rollout improves the efficiency of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) by reducing under-utilization during long-tail generation. Sustained concurrency also concentrates context processing into fewer decode steps, increasing the KV workload per step. We characterize this \emph{KV concentration} and find that KV cache quantization delivers substantially greater acceleration than weight-only and weight-activation quantization in our matched-workload comparisons. However, INT4 KV rollout can degrade learning even with token-level truncated importance sampling (TIS). We propose \emph{KV4-RL}, which combines calibration-free INT4 KV quantization with selective INT8 protection of attention sinks and recent context. Protecting a bounded number of positions reduces sampler mismatch while retaining most of the speedup from INT4. Across 400 iterations of Qwen3-8B-Base GRPO training, KV4-RL achieves $1.80\times$ cumulative rollout speedup and $1.27\times$ cumulative full-iteration speedup over BF16 rollout, reaching $1.97\times$ rollout speedup over the final 50 iterations. Under a common BF16 evaluator, its final six-benchmark mean accuracy is within 0.5 percentage points of BF16-rollout training for both Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base.

papers.title_en: VLCQ: Post-training quantization for deep neural networks using variable length coding
papers.authors: Reem Abdel-Salam, Ahmed H. Abdel-Gawad, Amr G. Wassal
papers.evidence: 使用变长编码的后训练量化压缩模型
papers.tldr: 后训练量化无需原始数据或重训，但现有高精度方法多依赖INT8定点编码，低位宽压缩常导致明显性能下降。VLCQ放宽定点编码约束，采用变长编码灵活探索量化方案，且无需训练数据或模型微调。在图像分类、分割和目标检测上，它优于多种先进PTQ方法；逐通道量化多数模型超过FP32与PWLQ，最高达6倍压缩，有限精度损失下可达12.25倍压缩。该工作为低位宽无数据量化提供了更灵活的压缩与精度权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Quantization plays a crucial role in efficiently deploying deep learning models on resource-constrained devices. Post-training quantization does not require access to the original dataset or retraining the full model. Current methods that achieve high performance close to baseline results typically require INT8 fixed-point integers. However, achieving higher model compression with lower bit-widths often leads to significant performance degradation. In this paper, we propose VLCQ, a post-training quantization method that relaxes the fixed-point encoding constraint, enabling more flexible exploration of quantization techniques through variable-length encoding. This approach achieves competitive or improved performance while reducing bit-widths, without requiring access to training data or model fine-tuning. Extensive experiments on image classification, segmentation, and object detection demonstrate that VLCQ improves model compression and accuracy compared with state-of-the-art post-training quantization approaches. For per-channel quantization, VLCQ surpasses FP32 accuracy and Piece-Wise Linear Quantization (PWLQ) on most evaluated models, achieving up to 6x compression compared with FP32 and up to 1.7x compared with PWLQ. When prioritizing compression with limited accuracy loss, VLCQ achieves up to 12.25x compression compared with FP32 with less than 4% performance degradation. For per-tensor quantization, VLCQ is competitive with Data-Free Quantization (DFQ), while providing greater flexibility to achieve lower bit rates across different tasks and models.
